_README: myKONE Assistant bot flow (Know / Track / Act / Hand over). Generated by build_kone_flow.py.
Load: PATCH /api/bots/:botId/flow with this file as the JSON body. Node ids are globally unique, so load it into ONE bot.

Replace before going live: REPLACE_ME_WEBHOOK_ID_MYKONE_CONNECTOR (myKONE connector webhook), REPLACE_ME_TEMPLATE_ID_CONTACT_FORM (contact form template), REPLACE_ME_SEGMENT_ID_DELIVERY_REMINDERS (segment 'Delivery task reminders'), and the text '[local KONE 24/7 service number]' in the emergency and fault messages.

With placeholders left in place, WEBHOOK and segment nodes throw and the bot replies with its generic fallback message (they do NOT take the FAILURE branch), so create the webhook and segment before demoing those paths. A placeholder template makes the contact form take FAILURE, which falls back to the in-chat questionnaire.
AI nodes have no clientId, so they use this bot's own knowledge base. Upload the KONE knowledge pack to this bot's training data.

Connector contract: the webhook POSTs {attributes, event, metadata}; event is one of delivery.projects, delivery.status, delivery.actions, equipment.status, equipment.next_visit, equipment.history, tenders.pending, tenders.list, reports.latest, reports.findings, invoices.open. Reply 2xx with {response:[{type:'text',value:'...'}], metadata:{}}. It must also answer the GET verification call JarCube makes before every POST. A non-2xx reply takes the FAILURE branch.

A new elevator goes through these stages in myKONE:
1. Order confirmed
2. Drawings approved
3. Production started
4. Equipment shipped
5. Delivered to site
6. Installation started
7. Installation completed
8. Final inspection completed
9. Project handed over
Some stages have tasks for you, such as approving drawings, confirming installation and handover dates, or getting the site ready. Ask "What do I need to do?" to see yours.

responses.value:
What tender statuses mean in myKONE:
• Pending approval: KONE has sent you a tender. Review it, then approve, reject or request a change.
• Waiting for PO number: you approved it. Add your purchase order number so KONE can plan the work.
• Waiting for signed tender: it needs your signature before work can start.
• Change requested: you asked for changes and KONE is updating the tender.
• Approved, Rejected, Cancelled, Expired: the tender is closed. Expired means no decision was made in time. Ask KONE for a new one if you still need the work.
Inspection reports. What would you like to do?
I can't load your inspection reports right now. You can find them in myKONE under Reports, with findings on the Active and Closed tabs.
Type or paste the finding as it appears in the report, and I'll explain it in plain language.
KONE prepares repair tenders for findings. When one is ready you'll see "Repair tender pending" on the finding, and the tender itself under Tenders.
Would you like me to ask your KONE contact about fixing the open findings?
OK. Any repair tender KONE prepares will appear under Tenders.
Invoices. What do you need?
I can't load your invoices right now. You can see them in myKONE under Invoices.
In myKONE, go to Invoices, open the invoice you need and download it as a PDF.
Invoices are only shown to users who have invoice access. Ask your company's myKONE admin to give you access, or I can put you in touch with KONE.
Sorry about that. Describe what went wrong in a sentence or two.
Thanks. If you can, attach a screenshot of the page. Otherwise type skip.
